description: Direct electrical stimulation of early visual cortex induces phosphenes, of postcentral gyrus somatosensory percepts, of temporo-parietal cortex visual motion, and of the right fusiform gyrus a disruption of face perception (studies reviewed by Boly and colleagues).
limitations: A review of intracranial studies in surgical patients, not a single experiment.

sources.quote: In contrast, electrical stimulation of the posterior cortex reliably induces discrete changes in the contents of consciousness
